text:
Alex K: FYI I opened a docs PR to reorganize the security section into a new 'Data lifecycle' subsection and added a concrete export example for audit logs. PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1248
Maria D: nice. can you include a short paragraph about per-tenant retention vs org-wide defaults? legal asked for clarity on scoping.
Alex K: yep — added a short matrix. also put an example showing export to JSONL + a sample header mapping for our audit format.
Chris T: can you drop in a tiny Go SDK snippet demonstrating the retention param? will help engineers migrate. i can mirror it to ruby after.
Alex K: added this example in the thread (feel free to tweak):
```go
client := redwood.NewClient(os.Getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
req := &redwood.ExportRequest{
  Model: "audit-logs-v1",
  Scope: "tenant:acme-corp",
  RetentionDays: 365,
}
resp, err := client.ExportAuditLogs(ctx, req)
if err != nil { log.Fatal(err) }
fmt.Println("export job:", resp.JobID)
```
Maria D: tiny nit — change `RetentionDays` to `retention_days` in the curl+json examples so the API examples match the public SDK names. Also can you add a note that values are enforced server-side and may be overridden by policy?
Julie (Security): please also include a link to our KMS rotation guidance and call out that exported audit files are encrypted at rest. link: https://internal.redwood.com/security/kms-rotation (we should use public docs path if we have one).
docs-bot: PR #1248 opened by alex-k — reviewers requested: @maria-d, @julie-security.
Chris T: updated Ruby snippet and curl in my fork, pushed a tiny README example. I shortened the example retention to 30 days to show default override behavior.
Alex K: LGTM from my side. Maria can you do a final pass on wording around 'retention period' vs 'TTL'? legal prefers 'retention period' in customer-facing docs.
Maria D: i can take a pass after lunch. quick checklist: 1) change param names to snake_case in examples 2) add server-side enforcement note 3) link to KMS and export encryption 4) add one sentence about tenant-scoped retention precedence.
Julie (Security): also include a brief checklist for auditors: what fields we export, pseudonymization status, and how long raw logs are kept in the pipeline. one bullet each.
Alex K: thanks — i'll fold those in once Maria sends wording. after that i'll request the merge.
Maria D: pushed wording tweaks and replaced the internal KMS link with public guidance URL. ready for merge unless Julie has a blocking ask.
Julie (Security): no blockers from security. :thumbsup:
Alex K: merging now. will follow up with a short release note and link in the compliance playbook.
Chris T: thanks all — super helpful.
Maria D: thanks! :heart:
